meaning: The classification result produced by analysis of a completed questionnaire response.

elements.name: question_ids
elements.meaning: The canonical ordered identifiers of the ten questions represented in the classification result.

members.text: Is extensive gangrene present involving most or all of the foot?
members.meaning: Determines whether gangrene is extensive and involves most or all of the assessed foot.

members.text: Is localized gangrene present involving only part of the foot?
members.meaning: Determines whether gangrene is localized to a limited portion of the assessed foot.
Determines whether an abscess is present in a deep tissue compartment or anatomical structure.
Determines whether infection and inflammation involving bone or bone marrow is present.
Determines whether a deep infection comparable in significance to a deep abscess or osteomyelitis is present.
Determines whether the assessed site has an ulcer with a break in the skin surface.

members.text: Does the ulcer extend into a deep anatomical structure such as tendon, joint capsule, muscle, joint, or bone?
members.meaning: Determines whether the ulcer extends beyond skin and superficial subcutaneous tissue into a deeper anatomical structure.

members.text: Is the ulcer limited to skin or superficial subcutaneous tissue?
members.meaning: Determines whether the ulcer remains superficial and does not extend into deeper anatomical structures.
Determines whether the skin at the assessed site is continuous and unbroken.

members.text: Does this assessment site represent an at-risk or previously ulcerated site with intact skin and no current open ulcer or higher-grade lesion?
members.meaning: Determines whether the assessed site represents the Wagner Grade 0 at-risk state rather than an active ulcerative, infectious, or gangrenous lesion.

elements.name: responses
elements.meaning: The normalized ordered response values used to produce the classification result.
elements.alignmentRule: For every array position n, responses[n] is the normalized response to question_ids[n].

values.meaning: The condition stated by the corresponding question is absent.
The condition stated by the corresponding question is present.
The corresponding question was not applicable or was not asked because of the questionnaire's adaptive logic.
The response required for the corresponding question is incomplete.

elements.name: analysis_status
elements.meaning: States whether the supplied response set supported a classification and describes the result of the analysis.

values.meaning: The response set satisfies exactly one Wagner grade definition, and a single score and grade label were produced.
The response set does not supply enough applicable findings to support a Wagner grade.
The response set supports more than one Wagner grade definition, so a single grade cannot be selected.
At least one response required to complete the classification is marked as incomplete.
The response set contains an internally inconsistent or logically incompatible combination of findings.

elements.name: wagner_score
elements.meaning: The computed Wagner classification grade represented as an array containing one integer from 0 through 5 when a grade is computed, or an empty array when no single grade is produced.

values.meaning: At-risk or previously ulcerated site with intact skin and no current open ulcer or higher-grade lesion.
Superficial ulcer limited to skin or superficial subcutaneous tissue.
Deep ulcer extending into a deeper anatomical structure without established deep abscess, osteomyelitis, comparable deep infection, or gangrene.
Deep ulcer with deep abscess, osteomyelitis, or a comparably deep infection.
Localized gangrene involving only part of the foot.
Extensive gangrene involving most or all of the foot.

elements.name: grade_label
elements.meaning: The human-readable label corresponding to the computed Wagner score, represented as a one-element array when a grade is computed or an empty array when no single grade is produced.

values.value: At-risk foot without an open ulcer
values.meaning: Label for Wagner Grade 0.
Label for Wagner Grade 1.
Label for Wagner Grade 2.

values.value: Deep ulcer with abscess or osteomyelitis
values.meaning: Label for Wagner Grade 3.
Label for Wagner Grade 4.
Label for Wagner Grade 5.
